name: How much does it cost to build an in-law suite in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build an in-law suite in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build an in-law suite in the Las Vegas area can vary significantly based on factors such as size, complexity, materials, and whether it's an addition or a conversion of existing space. A basic conversion might start from $50,000, while a new attached addition with full amenities could range from $100,000 to over $200,000. These are estimates, and a detailed quote would require an on-site assessment of your specific project needs and desired finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely in Las Vegas, from $50,000 for basic conversions to over $200,000 for new additions, depending on size and features.
